## Highlights

Preserve complete key events when a read ends after Escape and its continuation is already queued.
The fix covers Windows console records and Unix byte input.
It prevents a Down key from becoming Escape and stray text during slow application processing.
Genuine Escape presses retain their timeout behavior.

Fixes #146 through #147.

Both `uncurses` and `uncurses-ratatui` use version `0.0.9`.
The public API remains compatible with v0.0.8.

See the [installation guide](https://uncurses.org/docs/getting-started/installation/)
and [v0.0.9 API reference](https://docs.rs/uncurses/0.0.9).
